title: Reversed and voided invoices are excluded from every row, count and total under every Product Type
refs: specs/sbc-sales-by-customer.md Story 7 S7-R7; S7-N2; §3 Key Decisions
custom_preconds: 1. A customer has a known set of invoices in the current range, one of which you then reverse (or void) — seed ZZAUTOTEST data and note the totals before and after.
custom_steps:
1. Note the customer's invoice count "(N)" and totals with all invoices normal.
2. Reverse (or void) one of the invoices in the application.
3. Re-open/refresh the report under "Parts & Service" and re-read the count, rows, and totals.
4. Expand down to invoice rows and look for the reversed invoice.
custom_expected:
1. The reversed/voided invoice never appears as an invoice row.
2. It is excluded from the customer's "(N)" count and from every row total, regardless of the Product Type filter.
3. The customer/asset totals drop by exactly that invoice's amounts.
